observations: The final native front has a less harsh reflection boundary and a softer blue-green far-to-near transition than v39. The door and steelwork still produce recognizable live reflections.

The first procedural-glint version created continuous cyan lines, especially obvious in the oblique view. It was revised to shorter world-space patches with phase variation and a more neutral highlight color before release.

The final oblique render retains courtyard depth, the door, steel supports, reflected objects and visible submerged stone edges. Wave highlights stay on the water plane rather than facing the reference camera.

The final fixed-band mean RGB error is 4.0625 versus 13.6459 for v39. Mean absolute error in band luminance standard deviation is 0.01343 versus 0.06988. These statistics do not establish pointwise resemblance or whole-scene equivalence.
Water-bed stone shapes remain too subdued and do not match the poster. Some glint segments appear too straight and bright from the oblique camera, and reflected facade detail remains too distinct.
